profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of a senior development team responsible for building and maintaining enterprise-scale data processing pipelines supporting critical business operations. Partnered with Project Owners to help translate business requirements into technical solutions, bridging the gap between stakeholder needs and engineering execution. Aided fellow developers on the team by providing technical direction and helping work through complex challenges.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I was responsible for the development and stability of Java-based microservices on Google Cloud Platform supporting high-volume User targeted alerts for customers and integrating third party financial institutions into our alerting service.
